newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares ease, market lacking direction.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares ease, market lacking direction.

text.p: 1320 GMT - Austrian shares close slightly lower in moderate trade. Traders say no clear signal which way market will go but bias is on the upside.
* ATX index down 2.71 points or 0.23 percent at 1,170.16
* February ATX future down 2.5 points at 1,176
* 10 ATX shares up, eight down, three unchanged
* Luxury hosiery maker Wolford the biggest gainer, up 2.49 pct at 1,440 schillings
* Fibre maker Lenzing the leading decliner, down 4.63 percent at 596 schillings
* Vienna Bourse index down 0.48 points or 0.11 percent at 438.16
